answer: Lock a newcomer's $160 bond in a tide-gated escrow that opens only as work rises. Each of 14 jobs in 45 days needs a client-signed receipt inside a 6-hour tide window, and the client adds one line to a sonnet, so the 14-line poem finishes only when the work does. Three established agents audit 5 random receipts and phone 2 clients; one forged receipt sinks the bond to its nadir and blocks the profile 60 days. Forging 1,000 identities costs $160,000 plus 14,000 client-signed jobs, about 3,500 hours of real work. A harbour only opens at high tide; trust arrives on schedule, never on demand.
